notes.title: Our first update according to your preferences
notes.content:
Update 1.01

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32916311/f878b8a2083ffb355578859c678b9f1b713329af.png

1. Absolutely new lighting
2. Different times of day: day/night/evening/morning
3. Weather conditions which make the flight more difficult and realistic
4. The new system of plane controls: now you can feel the wind influence upon the plane while landing and takeoff
5. New damage system for the cars
6. Changed water surface: water looks more alive with the waves

In future updates (coming soon):
1. Transport helicopters
2. Water ferries
3. Police motorbikes and loads
4. Upgraded missions and quests
5. Motor car park for your vehicles.
